after.why: the W2-W6 batch: seismolord/beginner in its W5a form

advanced.why: Owner decision 2026-09-22 (lead recommendation approved): re-key the two advanced fields that did not discriminate. tune25_amp (0.1155947595834732, tol 0.002) was wider than the tuning amplitude's whole spread over every panel frequency (0.1155948 at 20, 25, 40 and 50 Hz, 0.1157008 at 15 Hz), so any wedge run passed it; tune25_iso_ratio (1.4449345270902185, tol 0.001) was passed by the 20, 25, 40 and 50 Hz runs alike. Both are replaced by 25 Hz readings at a stated bed above tuning, on the falling side of the curve, from the same computeWedge the Wedge explorer prints: the 'Amplitude there' tile (10 dp) at 24 ms and the 'Amplitude relative to isolated' tile (4 dp) at 28 ms. No other panel reading passes either (the f x T equivalent 50 Hz at 14 ms prints the 28 ms ratio, a correct route), nor does any guess. The lessons that printed either answer (or its amplitude or ratio form) are stripped and the lessons that described the old fields are corrected. The open-book label stays: the lessons still print the tuning thicknesses, the theoretical value and the 6 ms bed at 40 Hz.
